Both 30-second cuts use five exact manuscript excerpts, six seconds each, in the same sequence as the five social cards: sneakers → own style → clothes as background → wear rather than display → father’s wardrobe.

The vertical cut is 1080 × 1920; the landscape cut is 1920 × 1080. Transitions fade between static illustrations; audio is synthetic ambience. SRT/VTT reflect text-card timing.
